tools.name: query_ai_act_updates
tools.description: Query EU AI Act regulatory updates from primary sources. Returns structured events with titles, summaries, severity, topics and source URLs. Optionally filter by date range, source, topics, or severity. Use this when you need recent or historical regulatory changes affecting AI builders, GPAI provid

tools.name: get_obligation_for_role
tools.description: Look up the AI Act obligations for a specific role and AI-system risk category. Returns the relevant articles, recent guidance updates, and applicable templates. This is informational, not legal advice.

tools.name: summarize_changes_since
tools.description: Generate a structured digest of all AI Act regulatory changes since a given date, grouped by topic and severity. Useful for weekly compliance reviews or audit prep. Returns Markdown.

tools.name: lookup_article
tools.description: Look up a specific AI Act article (e.g. "Art. 53(1)(d)" or "Annex III") and return all related events from our pipeline plus the official EUR-Lex URL.
